scope: All public line/card identities; structural gaps, not a proof that every historical generation/engine/facelift is present.
priority: Descending Czech fleet.n where supplied; unknown register counts stay null and sort after known counts. No invented zero counts.
caveats: Register generation counts use existing ordinal mappings and are ranking evidence, not verification of historical generation identity.
No facelift record is not evidence that a facelift is missing: source comparison is required.
Equipment lines are distinct from technical engine/gearbox/drive versions.
A model absent from both indexes cannot be discovered by this internal audit.
